verdict.rationale: The Kong Gateway core is published on GitHub and documented for self-hosting via Docker, including a DB-less mode and an official Kubernetes Ingress Controller. It supports declarative or hybrid control-plane/data-plane deployments 'without any vendor lock-in', with a local Admin API on :8001 and Kong Manager UI on :8002. A community issue from an operator running their own Cassandra-backed nodes confirms real-world self-hosted use. Missing for 10: explicit open-source license evidence, and clarity on which AI Gateway and Konnect features (e.g., Catalog, Dev Portal, MCP autogeneration) are self-hostable versus SaaS- or enterprise-only.
